name: Bicycle & PMD servicing (category guide)
summary: Hydraulic disc brakes, foldie rust, and LTA PMD rules — shop vs mobile mechanic honesty, and why illegal e-scooter ‘tune-ups’ are a fine risk.
body: Expat cyclists and folding-bike owners hit the same gaps: hydraulic disc bleeds, seized chains after monsoon storage, and mobile mechanics who will come to the void deck. Chain shops (Rodalink-style) and independent specialists differ on parts stock and wait times — ask whether the quote includes parts or labour-only. Personal Mobility Devices sit under LTA device rules; ‘speed unlocks’ or non-compliant mods are enforcement risks, not clever hacks. Pair servicing with the cycling / active mobility guide for path rules and insurance questions. Condo bike-rack theft and rusty foldies after a long trip home are the usual triggers. This is a category guide for choosing honest workshops, not a ranked shop list.
